service_id.description: Service the action belongs to, if any (used for permission filtering).

task.description: Proxmox task id when the action started a task.

service_id.description: Service the alert belongs to, if any (used for permission filtering).

types.description: Types to change; types not listed keep their settings.

timezone.description: Quiet hours use this time zone (the server's local time).

home_order.description: Service ids in Home card order; services not listed follow in their default order.

logins_capped.description: True when more than [`MAX_PAGES`] pages of logins happened and the count is a floor.

update_available.description: Newer Authentik release, when the server reports it is outdated.

accent_chroma.description: OKLCH chroma of the accent tile (only differs for the neutral custom accent).

accent_hue.description: OKLCH hue of the service accent.

demo_vmid.description: Container id in the owner's current setup (demo/seed data only).

health_path.description: Path appended to the base URL for health checks.

kind.description: Module kind used for this preset. `None` = module not implemented yet.

level.description: Integration level from the design catalogue (full, read-only, health).

preset.description: Preset id, stored on service instances created from this entry.

days_left.description: Whole days left; negative when expired.

hosts.description: Number of proxy hosts using it.

ChannelInfo.description: What the settings page shows about a channel.

detail.description: Where it delivers (e.g. ntfy server and topic), or how to set it up.

name.description: Cluster name; `None` for a standalone node.

ConnectionTest.description: Result of testing a (possibly unsaved) service configuration.

presented_fingerprint.description:
SHA-256 fingerprint of the certificate the server presented, when it was not trusted.
Shown to the owner so they can pin it after checking it on the host.

id.description: Slug (`a-z`, `0-9`, `-`). Default: derived from the name.

secrets.description: Secret values by name (e.g. `token_secret`). Stored encrypted, never returned.

allowed_services.description: Guests only: service ids they may see.

can_act.description: Guests only: may run power and service actions.

Delivery.description: Result of delivering an alert on one channel.

push.description: An APNs token is registered (iOS push).

oneOf.description: A service's cached snapshot changed (sent after every poll).

data.description: A service's cached snapshot changed (sent after every poll).

oneOf.description: A user action started or finished (mirrors the activity log).

data.description: A user action started or finished (mirrors the activity log).

oneOf.description: An alert fired or was resolved (`alert.resolved_at` set).

data.description: An alert fired or was resolved (`alert.resolved_at` set).

Event.description:
An event on `GET /api/v1/events`. The SSE event name is the `event` field;
the SSE data is the JSON of `data`.

cpu_usage.description: CPU usage, 0.0–1.0 of the guest's cores.

linked_services.description: Quorum services linked to this guest (by service config or `svc-<id>` tag).

backup.description: Latest backup of this guest, including backup jobs over several guests.

last_backup.description: Latest finished backup (`vzdump`) task that names this guest.

qmp_status.description: QEMU guest state (`running`, `paused`, …) from the live status.

recent_tasks.description: Latest tasks for this guest (power actions, backups), newest first.

status_code.description: HTTP status code of the last response.

HealthCheckSettings.description: Settings of a health-check instance (the `settings` object of the service).

expected_status.description: HTTP: expected status code. Default: any 2xx or 3xx.

path.description: HTTP: path appended to the base URL (default `/`).

slow_ms.description: Responses slower than this are reported as a warning (default 2000 ms).

tls_fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint to pin for a self-signed HTTPS certificate.

backup.description: Guests: latest backup in the last 35 days.

detail.description: Second line, e.g. "CPU 18 % · RAM 58 %" or "99.9 % · 7 d".

headline.description: Main line, e.g. "3 nodes · 24 guests running" or "42 ms".

health.description: Worst state in that minute (`healthy`, `warning` or `down`).

LibraryItem.description: One series or movie (library grid, search, request tracker matching).

complete.description: Movies: file present. Series: all aired episodes present.

have.description: Series: episodes with a file / episodes aired. Movies: 0/1.

poster.description: Poster path on the service (`/MediaCover/…`), proxied by `/services/{id}/image`.

poster_url.description: Poster URL (TMDB image CDN), when known.

id.description: Episode id (Sonarr) or movie id (Radarr): used by the `search_item` action.

types.description:
Muted alert types. From a paired device these are the device's own mutes; from the
web, the user's (which also apply to all their devices).

songs.description: Songs in the library (from the scan status).

free_space.description: Free space in the data directory, bytes.

update_available.description: Newer Nextcloud version available (from Nextcloud's own update check).

temperature_c.description: Not exposed by the Proxmox API; filled by a future sensor source.

highlights.description: Enabled, visible services in Home order, without hidden ones.

nodes.description: Proxmox node strip (empty without a visible Proxmox service).

token.description:
Bearer token for `Authorization: Bearer …`. Shown once; store it in the Keychain.
`null` for the PWA, which gets it as an HttpOnly cookie instead.

code.description: Code to type on the device, formatted `XXXX-XXXX`.

qr_payload.description: Content for the QR code: `quorum://pair?server=<public url>&code=<code>`.

activity_id.description: Activity log entry; an `action` event follows when the task finishes.

ProxmoxSettings.description:
Settings of a Proxmox instance (the `settings` object of the service).
The token secret is stored as the encrypted secret `token_secret`.

fingerprint.description: SHA-256 fingerprint of the Proxmox certificate to pin (self-signed certificates).

online.description: Nginx accepted the host's config (`meta.nginx_online`), when reported.

environment.description:
`sandbox` (Xcode debug build) or `production` (TestFlight, ad hoc). Default: the
server's `[apns] environment`.

token.description: APNs device token, hex as the app gets it from `registerForRemoteNotifications`.

free_space.description: Free space in the default save path, bytes.

download_id.description: Download client id; the torrent hash for qBittorrent.

item_id.description: Series or movie id in Sonarr/Radarr.

message.description: Warning or error text (first status message or error message).

QuietHours.description: Quiet hours in the server's local time, `HH:MM`. The window may cross midnight.

RrdPoint.description: One RRD sample. Units: CPU 0.0–1.0, memory/disk in bytes, network/disk IO in bytes per second.

media_status.description: Media status if already known to Seerr.

SecretStatus.description: Whether a secret is stored. The value itself is never returned by the API.

ServerInfo.description: Basic information about the running server.

last_incident.description: Latest run of `down` minutes in the last 7 days.

points.description: Per-minute samples for the last 24 h, oldest first.

ServiceKind.description:
Kind of service module. Adding a service = adding a variant, a module file and a
registry entry in [`build_module`].

ServiceSnapshot.description: Cached state of one service instance: a common header plus module-specific data.

health_reason.description: Short human-readable reason when not healthy.

stale.description: True when the last poll failed and `data` is from an earlier successful poll.

ServiceView.description: A service as returned by the API: config (without secret values) plus live health.

accent_hue.description: OKLCH hue of the service accent.

linked_guest.description: The linked guest (by config or `svc-<id>` tag), if Proxmox knows it.

linked_vmid.description: Container/VM explicitly linked in the service config.

setup_token.description: The one-time token printed in the server log on first start.

needs_setup.description: True until the owner account exists.

user_id.description: User the device will belong to (default: the owner starting the pairing).

bitrate.description: Bits per second (transcode bitrate, or the source bitrate when playing directly).

remote.description: The client is not on a private network.

source.description: Source video codec and height, e.g. `HEVC 1080p`.

when.description: As Bazarr formats it (e.g. "2 hours ago").

exit_status.description: Exit status text (`OK` or the error).

chart.description: Queries per interval over the last 24 h.

paused_until.description: Set while blocking is paused; it resumes by itself at this time.

only_remote.description: Count only streams from outside the LAN (Jellyfin's "remote" sessions).

qbittorrent_id.description: qBittorrent service to throttle; the first one when unset.

engaged.description: The limits are on because of auto-throttle right now.

streams.description: Streams counted right now (after the remote-only filter).

ThrottleStatus.description: Current status for the qBittorrent page.

health.description: Worst state seen in the hour; `unknown` without samples.

domain.description: Client host name from reverse lookup, when known.

name.description: Domain name, or client IP for top clients.

arr_service_id.description: Sonarr/Radarr service and item, when matched.

torrent_service_id.description: qBittorrent service and torrent hash, when matched.

label.description: Requested, Approved, Grabbed, Downloading, Imported, Available.

UpdateService.description: Partial update. Absent fields stay as they are; `null` clears optional fields.

settings.description: Merged into the stored settings; a `null` value removes that key.

password.description: Set a new password (signs the user out everywhere on the web).

allowed_services.description: Guests only: service ids the guest may see.

can_act.description: Guests only: may run power and service actions on allowed services.

item_id.description: Sonarr series id or Radarr movie id (for `search`).

name.description: From the agent's names file, when set.

dl_speed.description: Bytes per second, across qBittorrent instances.

WidgetService.description: One number per visible service for the small widget ("Sonarr: 3 in queue").

streams.description: `null` without a visible Jellyfin or Navidrome.

agent_installed.description: False when no agent answers: the page shows install steps.
